title: Happy Sisters Shirley and Beverly Russell in Garden, 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Shirley & Beverly Russell 129 Shirley dressed in her Great Grand Father's suit - (W. T. Russell) (my Father Walter L. Russell)
description: A charming interwar family portrait showing young Shirley Russell sitting outdoors on the lawn holding her baby sibling Beverly in front of blooming daisy flowers. The photograph is enclosed within an Art Deco style geometric border characteristic of photo finishers from the late 1920s to 1930s. A handwritten family note on the reverse explains that Shirley is wearing an heirloom suit that once belonged to her great-grandfather, Walter T. Russell.
